messages:
tom: Quick thread to discuss "stepped burst pricing" idea. customers asked for predictable top-ups but with smoothing. Two proposals: 1) 'staged refill' (smaller refills every 2 days) 2) 'burst credit pool' (weekly allotment with optional buyback). Thoughts?
anya: product: finance prefers weekly pool. staged refill complicates billing and customer expectations.
ken: runtime: staged refill = more frequent ledger writes. The pool model is simpler.
chi: support: customers will ask about timezone alignment. For GA prefer UTC weekly refill.
sam: engineering estimate: pool model -> 2 sprints (billing + ledger). staged refill -> 3 sprints (more testing).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: "quota-ledger v2 rolled to staging (build 218)" :white_check_mark:
tom: ok decision: default weekly pool for GA, revisit staged refill in Q3 as an advanced option. action items: ken+sam final estimate, anya to update pricing doc, chi to prepare support FAQs.
